title: A $50,000 club fee, and it's not for the club
description: A top-tier private members' club charges tens of thousands of dollars just to join, and tens of thousands more every year to stay in. The dining room and the bar lose money on almost every meal they serve. The fee was never really paying for either of those.

scenes.narration: This club turns away most people who can pay.
scenes.imagePrompt: Extreme close-up on a heavy brass door pull and polished brass kick plate set into a solid dark walnut door, a gloved hand resting on the handle, the door open just a crack revealing a warm golden glow and a soft blurred marble hallway beyond, a rough-cut charcoal stone door surround filling the top third of the frame in shadow, honey-toned marble threshold glowing underfoot in bright daylight, vivid warm saturated color, everything in crisp sharp focus, deep depth of field

scenes.narration: Getting in starts with an initiation fee of fifty thousand dollars.
scenes.imagePrompt: A heavy brass fountain pen laid diagonally across a closed plain cream leather portfolio, shot from a low raking angle across a polished walnut reception desk inside a private members' club, the portfolio's bare cover catching a sliver of warm midday sunlight while most of it falls into soft shadow, a dark wood-panelled wall filling the top third of the frame in shadow, vivid warm saturated color, everything in crisp sharp focus, deep depth of field

scenes.narration: Then come annual dues of another twenty thousand, whether you ever visit or not.
scenes.imagePrompt: An empty round dining table inside a private members' club dining room, a crisp white linen cloth, a single unused place setting with heavy silverware and a folded napkin, warm daylight falling across the table from a tall window, a dark coffered ceiling filling the top third of the frame in shadow, vivid warm saturated color, everything in crisp sharp focus, deep depth of field

scenes.narration: The dining room and the bar still lose money on almost every meal served.
scenes.imagePrompt: A richly stocked private club bar at quiet midday, rows of backlit crystal decanters on a dark mirrored shelf, a bartender's hands polishing a glass behind a polished brass rail, warm daylight spilling in from a side window, a dark timber ceiling beam filling the top third of the frame in shadow, vivid warm saturated color, everything in crisp sharp focus, deep depth of field

scenes.narration: So the money was never really paying for the food, or the room.
scenes.imagePrompt: A quiet private club library lounge in warm daylight, two deep cognac-leather wingback chairs beside an unlit stone fireplace, tall bookshelves glowing amber in soft shadow, a shaft of sunlight crossing a herringbone parquet floor, a dark plaster ceiling filling the top third of the frame in shadow, vivid warm saturated color, everything in crisp sharp focus, deep depth of field

scenes.narration: It pays a committee whose entire job is deciding who does not belong.

scenes.narration: Membership works less like a purchase and more like a background check with a price attached.
scenes.imagePrompt: A pair of hands reviewing a thick cream reference folder at a polished mahogany desk inside a private members' club office, warm afternoon sunlight falling across the paper, a dark leather-bound ledger stacked beside it, a dark wood-panelled wall filling the top third of the frame in shadow, vivid warm saturated color, everything in crisp sharp focus, deep depth of field

scenes.narration: The fee was never admission. It is the club paying to keep the wrong people out.
